snippet.title: Sova - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3191070/Sova/
